Results.ReviewText: Grilling should be easy, and the Weber Spirit II E-210 makes it so. It is a well designed and refined grill and a joy to use. Mounting the propane tank is easy, and the tank weight gage is a nice bonus feature. The grill lights easily and the ignitor batteries are easily accessed when replacement is needed. The temperature controls work very well and heat is distributed evenly across the entire cook surface. The porcelainized cast iron grates are reversible - a feature I don't normally use, but it is there for those who do. The grease control system on this grill actually works and grease is collected in an easy to reach foil pan which can be dumped out or replaced entirely. It is a rare occasion that I would need more cooking space than this grill offers, as this one can probably hold 16 burgers at a time. Most of the time it is just my wife and I, so this grill was the perfect choice. I am confidant that I will get many years of use, but it is too new to know how well it will perform over time, hence the 4 star rating.

Enter the Spirit II e-210.  I decided to jump into propane grills and since I trust Weber, this is the one for me.  It's small and fits nicely in my backyard, but the cooking surface is large enough for a small crowd.  I've done 2 porterhouse steaks, potatoes, corn and a couple hot dogs at one time and never felt that the cooking area was too small or that anything was missing out on heat.

I love how fast it heats up, how quickly it cools down and the absolute convenience of turning it on and within 5 minutes being able to grill.  My only gripe is on price, it's not inexpensive and time will tell if that translates to quality.  Also, I went with red and this is a brilliant shade of red.

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.

44020001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill
44020001.Description: Open your door to the world of grilling with the sleek Spirit II E-210 gas grill. This two burner grill is built to fit small spaces, and packed with features such as the powerful GS4 grilling system, iGrill capability, and convenient side tables for placing serving trays. Welcome to the Weber family.
